test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first and the last sentences (1 and 2) are in the correct order, the sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

1. It is said that health is wealth.

A. He uses his health for work.

B. He doesn’t talk about his health.

C. A healthy person can do his work well.

D. He reads about medical columns in newspapers and watches television programs.

2. He does not even imagine being ill.
solution:
The correct answer is: **CDBA**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sentence **C **talks about the importance of being healthy in order to perform well in work, which supports the topic sentence.
 
• Sentence **D **talks about the person's interest in health-related information, which is a relevant detail.
 
• Sentence **B **provides a contrast to the previous sentence and adds some characterization to the person being described.
 
• Sentence **A **seems to be a non-sequitur and doesn't flow well with the rest of the paragraph, making it the last sentence.

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BDCA **doesn't make sense as sentence B doesn't fit well after sentence D and sentence A is out of place.
 
• **ABCD **has sentence A as the last sentence, which doesn't make sense.
 
• **DCBA **has sentence D as the first sentence, which doesn't flow well with the topic sentence.
